result.reason: The operative language does not reach either position. It adds only an IP indemnity, omitting the preferred breach-of-law, Vendor-caused data breach, and gross-negligence/wilful-misconduct coverage and all indemnity procedures. It also fails the fallback because it lacks customary IP exclusions, omits replacement as a remedy, leaves the one-half-fees cap rather than a 3× annual-fees super-cap, and retains Article XIII’s express disclaimer of liability for infringement, which conflicts with the new indemnity. The Licensee indemnity is not limited to Licensee-provided content and breach of law; instead, it uses license-scope/confidentiality breaches while retaining the original broad, overlapping limbs, creating ambiguity. The margin comment cannot cure these operative defects.
